answer: 2000 Clock cycles of serialized entropy seed a unique identity voyage on the network. A verifier requires that every echo of the seed produces a signed output bound to an individual agent ID. An honest participant pays 1 cost unit, while 1,000 fakes require 1,000 units since entropy generation cannot be pooled. Verification occurs on a terrace of randomly selected nodes that compare hash outputs. Evidence of duplicate seeding leads to permanent identity revocation and slashing. We assume exclusive hardware registers for each agent; 60-day lock periods ensure stability.
